x: In the 100 yards (under 19) we only had five runners and Frank Kemp was the winner in the good time of 10.4 seconds. We made up two heats in the 100 yards Boys (under 16) race and the final was won by Don Clements from Malden.
Cornish with Frank Kemp second and Alan Law third. The 880 yards (under 19) saw only four starters and Maurice Jones put in a good finish to beat Maclean, much to the latter's surprise.
The holder, Denis Merrett, was unable to run owing to injury. Frank Kemp retained his 100 yards junior title with P.
Cornish second and Frank Kemp third. The latter ran well off a back mark but is considering taking it easy for the next season or two.

In the Youths 4 x 110 we only had three lads present and so could not field a team, while in the Junior 4 x 110 yards, our team of Kemp, Benstead, Laverick and Byrne could only finish 2nd to Mitcham A.C., the A.A.A.
Marshall, our new Army member, Morris won from Kemp and Coleman in a new championship best of 50.3s. This was followed by the Junior which was won by Coxall in 52.8s just outside the record.
